result.title: Feature Engineered Reinforcement Learning for S-pair Selection in Buchberger's Algorithm
result.summary: Selecting the order in which to process S-pairs is a crucial decision in Buchberger's algorithm for computing Groebner bases: this choice can change the cost by orders of magnitude. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning agents viewing exponent vectors of the polynomials outperform classical heuristics on binomial ideals. We extend this line of work to general polynomial ideals by using statistical features. We introduce a 17-dimensional feature vector to describe a polynomial and use PPO to train policies on five distributions of random ideals. We find that using S-polynomial features significantly outperforms S-pair features on all five distributions. The new policies also outperform the retrained RL baseline on all five distributions, reducing algorithmic work by 41--53\% relative to the degree heuristic on four distributions where learning helps. The additional cost of the feature engineering means that wall-clock cost remains similar to the baseline, but our new approach benefits from easier transfer to unseen distributions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 Buchberger 算法中 S-pair 处理顺序的选择建模为强化学习问题，设计 17 维多项式统计特征并用 PPO 在五类随机理想分布上训练策略，发现基于 S-polynomial 的特征普遍优于 S-pair 特征，相对度启发式减少 41–53% 的算法工作量。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作用人工特征刻画算法运行中的中间状态来指导序贯决策，其「状态表示层级的选择直接决定策略效果与跨分布迁移」的观察，可能为 LVR 中内部状态应保留何种信息、以及选择/停止决策的表示设计提供类比线索，但领域相距较远，需核查具体可迁移程度。
